rule_as_ruled: ASYMMETRY: per member, at the along-stations +-600/1200/1800/2400 (star_stations geometry, r=400, top-30 FWHM (x+y)/2), the zone onset is the smallest dx where FWHM(+dx) - FWHM(-dx) > 0.20 px and stays above outward; x_c = onset - 300; a member with no station over the bar is NOT cropped. Intrinsic: no reference member, no ranking.

intrinsic (the GO as first specified: FW.verdict: REFUTED before building — it measures the lens's radial field term on BOTH sides
intrinsic (the GO as first specified: FW.coverage_consequence_header_only: band full-box coverers x10 4 -> 1, x15 13 -> 3, x20 36 -> 7, x25 58 -> 11-17; the reference member 36 cropped
intrinsic (the GO as first specified: FW.why_0p06_misled: july31/set-01's CENTRE is soft (2.34-2.44 vs 2.23-2.31 at +600/+1200): its profile dips off-centre, so its gradient read small; on every other night the centre is the sharpest station

absolute (FWHM(+dx) > 2.80 px).verdict: REJECTED — keys on delivered shape, not the lens; would crop a uniformly soft night entirely
